summary: Full backend hardening + regression verification for Zikirhane (Expo/RN, mobile viewport 390x844). Backend: 5 passed, 1 skipped. GET /api/ → 200 {status:ok}, POST /api/status → 404, GET /api/status → 404, /docs and /openapi.json disabled at FastAPI level (direct backend returns 404; through ingress the SPA is served — expected ingress routing, not a backend leak). CORS: FastAPI code correctly sets allow_origins=[] (verified: direct backend emits NO Access-Control-Allow-Origin), but the Kubernetes ingress in front adds 'access-control-allow-origin: *' at the infra layer — not fixable in app code. Mobile app regression PASSED end-to-end: splash → onboarding-skip → home; counter-tap-area increments to 5, undo-button → 4, target-selector opens with target-33/99/100/500 chips all visible, target-99 selects (4/99 label), active-dhikr-selector shows 6 dhikr-pick-* options, reset-button + reset-confirm resets counter, Zikirlerim tab shows tesbihat-card + esma-card; Tesbihat opens (Sübhanallah / 0/33) and survives 120 rapid taps (30ms interval) with NO red-screen crash — previous CRITICAL race is FIXED; Esma renders 74 rows in DOM (virtualized FlatList for 99 items); custom dhikr add via add-dhikr-fab works (dhikr-name-input + save-dhikr-btn); İstatistikler now exposes daily-goal-card, weekly-chart, top-dhikrs-list (previously missing testIDs — FIXED); Ayarlar shows theme-switch (flips dark↔light live), vibration-switch, goal-100 chip. Persistence verified: counter=4 preserved and onboarding NOT re-shown after full page reload. Zero backend/CORS/network related console errors on the mobile app (only Cloudflare cdn-cgi/rum telemetry aborts — unrelated).

minor.issue: Kubernetes ingress injects 'access-control-allow-origin: *' for /api/* even though FastAPI middleware has allow_origins=[]. Direct backend (curl http://localhost:8001/api/) correctly returns NO CORS headers. This is an infra-level override outside app code scope.

action_items: OPTIONAL/INFRA: The public preview URL returns 'access-control-allow-origin: *' for /api/* due to the Kubernetes ingress layer, even though FastAPI has allow_origins=[]. If strict CORS lockdown is required end-to-end, coordinate with platform/infra to remove the wildcard from ingress annotations — nothing to change in app code.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend /app/backend/server.py is minimal (52 lines), correctly disables docs_url/redoc_url/openapi_url, uses CORSMiddleware with allow_origins=[], and exposes only GET /api/. No MongoDB usage remains. Clean.

Previous iteration_1 critical issues verified as FIXED in this iteration: (a) Tesbihat rapid-tap race no longer crashes (120 taps @ 30ms — no red screen); (b) testIDs weekly-chart, top-dhikrs-list, daily-goal-card, theme-switch, vibration-switch, goal-100, add-dhikr-fab, save-dhikr-btn, dhikr-name-input all present and visible.

success_rate.backend: 100% (5/5 executed passed, 1 skipped for infra CORS override)
